channel.title: EdgeLine AI leans
channel.description: Sports betting leans from a game-data model: every lean with our probability and its edge over the price, every grade, every slate. In a replay of past seasons these leans did not beat the closing price (NHL −4.8%, NBA −7.9%, NFL −9.5% ROI at the close). They become picks when the live record beats the close. Informational only; 21+.

item.title: Mon Nov 9 slate: No lean tonight: 118 sides priced in 20 games, none clears its bar
item.description:
Every main-line side was given our probability from the game data. None sits above what its best price implies by its own bar (3 points or more: the model's margin of error on that side), so there is no bet.

In a replay of past seasons these leans did not beat the closing price (NHL −4.8%, NBA −7.9%, NFL −9.5% ROI at the close). They become picks when the live record beats the close.
